citations.assessment: Rashi expressly contrasts a sharp young student with the other expression for an older scholar. Heilprin’s brief adjective is preserved.
Rav Pappa reports what happened after a man spoke about Mar Shmuel. The justification is a distinct next line without a named speaker in the received text.
Rava calls Abba bar Marta, also named Abba bar Minyomi, a tzurba me-rabbanan when he visits a mourner.
Abaye draws a general rule from an episode with R. Yehoshua and Hanina’s daughter-in-law. Preserve Heilprin’s application of the rule to the elder Yehoshua.
The alternative wording likens Rav Menashya bar Tahlifa to a tzurba when he reviewed teachings received from the sages.
His dedicated Heilprin entry quotes the same story and locator.
Abaye’s maxim comes from a pair of short exchanges in a dispute about laying on hands.
Rava discusses disclosure where unknown and requesting precedence, in two different passages.
Both judicial maxims are at the beginning of the folio. Bavli puts Rava first and Mar bar Rav Ashi second; Heilprin reverses their order without changing speakers.
